sourceRefs.locator: VI.46 and VII.4–5, 7: Chilperic’s death in 584, Paris, sanctuary under Ragnemod, the golden dish, messengers to Guntram and the infant Chlothar.
Abstract, pp. 48–49: seventeen episcopal supporters, donations and Gregory’s portrayal of Chilperic and Fredegund.

summary.de: Gemahlin Chilperichs und Mutter Chlothars II. Aus Paris suchte sie nach Chilperichs Tod den Schutz Guntrams.
summary.en: Wife of Chilperic and mother of Chlothar II. After Chilperic died, she appealed to Guntram from Paris.
